schema.description: Request schema for updating a booking intent

auto_assign_provider.description: When true, automatically assigns an available provider for the selected time slot if no provider_id is specified.

booking_policy.description: Policy overrides for this booking intent. When omitted, falls back to the service's policies if service is changing.

duration.description: The duration of the hold as an ISO 8601 duration string.

client_data.description: Progressive client data. Provided fields are merged with existing values.

fields.description: A map of custom field key-value pairs.

client_id.description: The ID of an existing client to link.

end_at.description: The end time of the slot as an ISO-8601 datetime string with a timezone offset.

locked_fields.description: Fields to lock from public API updates. Replaces existing locked_fields entirely.

metadata.description: Custom metadata key-value pairs. Replaces existing metadata entirely.

provider_id.description: The ID of the provider to assign.

secondary_providers.description: Secondary providers to include in the appointment. Send an empty array to clear.

slot_prevalidated.description: Whether the slot has been prevalidated. Automatically reset to false when slot-relevant fields (service_id, provider_id, start_at, end_at, time_zone) change, unless explicitly set to true in the same request.

start_at.description: The start time of the slot as an ISO-8601 datetime string with a timezone offset.

submissions.description: Form submissions to upsert by form_id. Provided entries are merged with existing submissions; omitted form_ids are left unchanged. Send an empty array to clear all.

items.description: A form submission entry containing a form ID and response data.

form_id.description: The ID of the form to submit responses for.

responses.description: A map of response data keyed by field key. Values depend on field type.

items.title: IntentSubmissionInput

time_zone.description: The local time zone for the slot (IANA format).

schema.title: UpdateBookingIntentRequest
